ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Use Pillars of Islam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Pillars of Islam has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of Islam.
   D. Apply the teaching of Pillars of Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Hiding stolen items

3. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah? (1 mark)
   A. Use Selected Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Selected Surah has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah.
   D. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic etiquettes? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic etiquettes.
   B. Apply the teaching of Islamic etiquettes with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Islamic etiquettes has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Islamic etiquettes to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on:? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on:.
   C. Use Hadith on: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Hadith on: has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic phrases? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Islamic phrases with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic phrases.
   C. Say Islamic phrases has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Islamic phrases to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Manners of eating By the end of the sub-strand? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Manners of eating By the end of the sub-strand with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Manners of eating By the end of the sub-strand.
   C. Say Manners of eating By the end of the sub-strand has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Manners of eating By the end of the sub-strand to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

9. Which response best shows understanding of Relationship? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Relationship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Relationship has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Relationship to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Relationship.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Love for parents? (1 mark)
   A. Say Love for parents has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Love for parents with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Love for parents.
   D. Use Love for parents to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Birth of Prophet? (1 mark)
   A. Use Birth of Prophet to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Birth of Prophet.
   C. Say Birth of Prophet has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Birth of Prophet with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Environment School cleanliness? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Environment School cleanliness.
   B. Apply the teaching of Environment School cleanliness with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Environment School cleanliness has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Environment School cleanliness to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Arabic Alphabet 1.0 QUR’AN and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Selected Surah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Birth of Prophet and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Hadith on: and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

2. B — Telling the truth and keeping trust

4. B — Apply the teaching of Islamic etiquettes with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. A — Apply the teaching of Hadith on: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. A — Apply the teaching of Islamic phrases with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. A — Apply the teaching of Manners of eating By the end of the sub-strand with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. D — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

9. A — Apply the teaching of Relationship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. B — Apply the teaching of Love for parents with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. D — Apply the teaching of Birth of Prophet with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. B — Apply the teaching of Environment School cleanliness with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Arabic Alphabet 1.0 QUR’AN; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Birth of Prophet; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
